lines.en: Lowers its fangs as it advances
Sssss as it approaches its prey
Sssss as it moves through bushes

lines.zh: 我拖着一条腿，蹭着地面。
lines.en: I drag one leg, scraping the ground.

lines.zh: 在废墟里翻找还能用的。

lines.en: Slowly turn its head, looking around
Slowly turn its head, surveying its surroundings

lines.zh: 我盯着你的口袋，磨着牙。
lines.en: I stare at your pockets, grinding my teeth.
Stares at the player, ready to pounce
I'll be taking that pack of yours.
Stares at the player, grinding its teeth in anticipation
Stares at the player, ready to act
Stares at the player, ready to pounce
Stares at the player, ready to attack
Stares at the player, ready to pounce
Stares at the player, grinding its teeth in preparation
That blade on your belt is mine.

lines.zh: 你那破盾根本伤不了我！

lines.en: You want to sneak attack me? No way!
Angered by you, I'll strike you down!

lines.zh: 你的箭根本射不穿我的皮！
lines.en: Your arrow can't pierce my skin!
I'll take care of you this time!

lines.zh: 你这么说我都不打你了！
lines.en: I won't fight you if you say so.

lines.zh: 别再靠近我，不然吃我一剑！
lines.en: Don't get closer, or I'll stab you!

lines.zh: 你背包里的罐头，叮当响。
lines.en: The cans in your pack are clinking.

lines.zh: 我等的就是你这种猎物。
lines.en: I've been waiting for you as prey.

lines.zh: 这具尸体还有口袋，翻一翻。
lines.en: This corpse still has pockets. Let me search.

lines.zh: 我背包里还有你的东西。
lines.en: I've got your things in my pack.
That knife at your belt is mine now.
Don't think you can run away.

lines.zh: 你是我的猎物，无处可逃。
lines.en: You're my prey, nowhere to run.
I shoulder past you and take the lead.
My speed is fast, be careful!
What's it like to be crushed?

lines.zh: 我是你的伴侣，一起繁衍。
lines.en: I'm your partner, reproduce with me.

lines.zh: 我先咬一口，剩下的归你。
lines.en: I take the first bite; you get the rest.
Bite me, and you'll become like me.

lines.zh: 快吃这些！你很快会像我一样！
lines.en: Eat this! You'll soon be like me.

lines.zh: 尝尝这个，你将永远改变！
lines.en: Try this, you'll be changed forever!

lines.zh: 抓到你了，现在你属于我了！

lines.en: My strength is in the blood!

lines.zh: 别试图反抗，你会变成我的！
lines.en: Don't resist, you'll become like me!

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，我已经看见你了！
lines.en: You can't escape, I've seen you!

lines.zh: 你包里的东西，我全要了。
lines.en: Everything in your pack is mine now.
Whatever's in your bag is mine.
Drop the pack and you can go.

lines.zh: 别喊，附近还有我们的人。
lines.en: Don't shout. More of us are nearby.

lines.zh: 剁了你的腿，你就跑不掉。
lines.en: I take a leg and you stop running.

lines.zh: 你腰上那把刀，是我的了。
lines.en: That knife at your belt is mine now.
You'll become one of my kind!

lines.zh: 你包里的东西我都数过了。
lines.en: I've counted everything in your pack.
You'll pay the price for me!
Let me get one bite in first.
You'll lie down like the others.
Lose enough blood and you can't stand.
My blade has never been washed.
I'll wait for the bleeding to drop you.

lines.zh: 你抓着伤口的样子真好看。
lines.en: I like the way you clutch that wound.

lines.zh: 我把撬棍在手里转了一圈。
lines.en: I spin the crowbar once in my hand.
There are no doctors out here.

lines.zh: 我的指甲缝里全是泥和血。
lines.en: Mud and blood are packed under my nails.

lines.zh: 这双手扒过太多垃圾堆。
lines.en: These hands have picked through too many dumps.
I bite down and my teeth loosen.

lines.zh: 这双手早就不算人的手了。
lines.en: These hands stopped being human long ago.
That bite mark will last a lifetime.
Don't struggle. It only sinks deeper.
You'll be one of us soon.
Prying that knife from your hand.
When the moon rises, I go out.

lines.zh: 腐烂的气息将引诱他们！

lines.en: I've guarded these cans three days.

lines.zh: 你那破盾根本伤不了我，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Your shield can't hurt me! — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 还想偷袭我？没门，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: You want to sneak attack me? No way! — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 被你惹毛了，吃我一击，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Angered by you, I'll strike you down! — and the magic makes it worse.

lines.zh: 你的箭根本射不穿我的皮，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Your arrow can't pierce my skin! — and the lightning makes it worse.
